main_text.p: facere? Augustinus certè ad infantes de visibilibus elementis consecratis, distinctè scribit, Quod vidistis, panis est & calix, quod vobis etiam oculi renuntiant: quod autem fides vestra postulat instrumen-da, panis est corpus Christi, & calix est san-guis. Porrò cùm in cœna Domini hoc vel in primis opus facto fit, vt nos ob-temperantes Christi mandato, tota mente ac cogitatione in verissimum ipsius corpus & sanguinem feramur, nullo iam amplius panis & vini habito quasi respectu: assuefacere voluerunt sancti patres ad hanc meditationem rerum cælestium suas & aliorum mentes, ne in terrenis & visibilibus elementis diutius hærerêt, sed his pro-pemodum neglectis, corda sursum levarent, ad agnum immaculatum in sacra mensa positum cõsiderandum.

page.notes: The faint mark at the start of the second paragraph (a small dash before "Progressu") is probably a printer's ornament or type mark, not text. The catchword "tius" is the rest of the hyphenated word "impudentius", placed alone at the right below the text. The signature reads roughly "b. ii." and is faint. Uncertain letters: "hærerêt" (accent over the final e), "facto" (possibly "factò"). Long s is written as s throughout.
